question.prompt: Connecting the midpoints of consecutive sides of quadrilateral \(ABCD\) forms quadrilateral \(EFGH\). Given that the diagonals have lengths \(AC=8\) and \(BD=6\), find the perimeter of quadrilateral \(EFGH\).

solutions.explanation: Draw \(AC\) and \(BD\). By the midsegment theorem, \(EF=HG=AC/2=4\) and \(FG=EH=BD/2=3\). The perimeter is \(2\times(4+3)=14\).
solutions.title: Midsegments along the diagonals
